B.name: Harim
B.line: A priest who seals Nehemiah's covenant

first_reader_said: NEH 10:5: A, the priestly house of Harim, is already noted as sealing at 10:5, and B is that same priestly sealer.

why: 1CH 24:8 places Harim in the priestly divisions established in David’s time, whereas NEH 10:5 names a priest sealing Nehemiah’s covenant centuries later. EZR 2:39, EZR 10:21, NEH 7:42, and NEH 12:15 concern Harim’s descendants or priestly house; they do not establish that its earlier namesake was the later sealer. A’s NEH 10:5 attribution belongs to B.
